description: Annual total ocurrence of Kuiseb River flooding from 1962 to 2023 at Gobabeb, Namibia is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by figshare. The ephemeral Kuiseb River periodically recharges shallow alluvial aquifers, which can provide essential water sources for riparian deep-rooted trees and wildlife (Kaseke et al. (2018, doi:10.4209/aaqr.2017.01.0062)). The annual occurrence days of Kuiseb River flooding at Gobabeb from 1964 to 2019 were collected from Morgan et al. (2021, doi:10.3390/rs13010051). Coverage: Namibia. The portal files it under the publisher figshare. Its tags are Surface water hydrology. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
